# Sherin Thomas

Sherin Thomas is a Lead Data Scientist at Aviso. After completing her Masters in Computer Science from IIT Hyderabad, Sherin has worked in various industries like Oil&Gas, Media and Banking, developing advanced AI solutions as cloud native applications and thereby delivering robust and scalable data products for enhanced customer experience, risk management and operational efficiency. Beyond work, Sherin enjoys cruising on long drives and soaking in nature.
